notes: Carpet Cloud No-Replace Guard. Fixes the regression where background cloud recovery could silently replace the entire local Carpet Inventory with an older/incomplete cloud copy, causing a roll such as 2347 to disappear after refresh or upgrade. Carpet Inventory cloud downloads now reconcile device and cloud roll-by-roll and preserve rolls present on either side. Exact operational roll identity is preserved, so 2347 and RC2347 are not treated as the same roll. Build062 desktop/cloud inspector and Build063 Word tag layout lock remain unchanged. No database schema change.
